main_text.l: Praterit ad levam Meinfeldi jugera longè,
Imminet à dextris Alcona, spectat aquam
Flumine jam fesso longius ire nequit.
Vt Boream leva dextris suspexit Eoum
main_text.p: Mosa ex montis Vogesi radice prope castrum Neoburgum scatu-riens Birseni & Sorsonæ gurgitibus absorptis Michaelis fanum Verdenum, Maseriam, Iambelium, Namurcam transit, ibidemque Sabi fluvio ab Hannonia deducto hausto, Hogenum Leodium fluviisque inibi Legia, Murtio & Aspro iterum auctus, Visetum, & Trajectum praeterit: ex Tongria vero Icaria nacto Gelenium prope Sittardum lambit: ubi quoque fundo suo deserto quasi in aere penderet, juxta Sufterenam subsistit: tum Stepha-insulanum, Hornaeum, atque Gugernos pertransit; & Rurcmundæ, Ruræ, de quo mox, junctus castellum Venlonum Blariaco objectum, & tandem Gennepium praeterlabens ibidem Niero commixtus, Ravensteinium, Gravenum, Bataburgum, Moeganum castra transit, ubi Vahali commixtus, moxque ab eodem flectens flumine Pomello laeva dextera Boxtelum, Pælandiam, Helmontum adit, indeque Sylvam Ducis delatus circa rupem Leoniam Vahali absorpto in mare defertur, de quo ita idem Bernhardus Mollerus in descriptione Rheni:
main_text.l: Mosa caput fontis Vogesi radice meretur
Fluctifer hic Mosa cornua Sabis init.
Sabis ab Hannonia deducit divite fontem,
Praterit Hoienum modico non agmine Mosa
Legia praelustri no bilis amne latex.
Vrtius Arduenna flumen ab orbe ferens.
Nomine Viseti qua jam Taxandria pollet
Vrbs veterum pollet laude, propinquat aquis.
Dives ab antiquo Trajectum tempore surgit

page.notes: Verse lines in italics; the prose paragraph is set in roman with italic-free text. Some letters are faint (e.g. "Aspro" may contain a Cyrillic-looking o; read as Aspro). Small marginal mark at right edge near the first verse block is a printer's dot, not text.
